components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident forest action for the main task.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button">Start a handoff <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8h10M8 3l5 5-5 5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--forest); border-radius: 0; color: var(--stock-light); background: var(--forest); font: 700 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--forest-deep); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--red); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { color: var(--forest); background: #d9ded1; border-color: #a9b5a2; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; color: var(--forest); background: transparent; font: 700 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--forest); background: rgba(24, 56, 47, .05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--red); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square light-stock field with a clear focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: var(--forest); font: 700 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--stock-light); font: 400 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--forest); outline: 3px solid var(--red); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Forest navigation with a sage current-page rule.
components.html: ShareOSend a fileHow it works
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; color: var(--stock-light); background: var(--forest); font: 700 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand { font: 700 25px 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; text-transform: none; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 0; } .ds-current { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--sage); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--red); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--red); color: var(--red); font: 700 9px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .11em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--red); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ledger Fact Row
components.description: Tabular limits and expiry facts grouped by thin rules.
components.css: .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-facts div { padding: 12px 14px 13px 0; } .ds-facts div + div { padding-left: 14px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-facts dt { color: var(--muted); font: 700 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-facts dd { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--forest); font: 700 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
ShareO treats a file handoff as a temporary record. Warm stock sets the page; forest ink organizes the action, vermilion marks time-sensitive states, and sage provides quiet indexing. Ruled fields, factual metadata, and a single stamp-like completion cue give the interface its character without relying on decorative texture or a graphic logo.

Condensed Barlow carries display headlines while DM Sans keeps form instructions and controls readable. Surfaces stay square and paper-toned; depth comes from thin rules and a soft, offset shadow on task sheets rather than glass, gradients, or nested cards.
keyCharacteristics: Forest framing with warm stock surfaces.
Vermilion used as a sparse state mark; sage used for quiet navigation cues.
Condensed display lettering paired with humanist interface text.
Square controls, ruled metadata, and tabular numerals.
ShareO is set as text; there is no graphic logo.

rules.name: The Stamp Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Keep vermilion for expiry, errors, and a few active details; forest remains the primary action color.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for limits, progress, and expiry values; keep labels distinct from values without switching to a monospaced costume.

rules.name: The Soft Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows stay offset and blurred; do not add hard, zero-blur shadows or colored halos.

dos: Do keep ShareO as text and do not add a graphic logo.
Do use the forest action color, warm stock ground, and sparse vermilion state marks.
Do keep file limits, expiry, and optional password facts explicit near the handoff form.
Do keep controls square and make keyboard focus visible.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, or decorative texture to imitate paper.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as interface icons; use the existing authored SVG style.
Don't add repeated stamp animations; the link-ready state owns the single stamp reveal.
Don't imply privacy or security guarantees beyond the implemented product behavior.
